project.name: LearnBuddy
project.description: LLM-powered personalized learning planner and AI tutor demo with lesson scheduling and YouTube transcript support.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and package manifest to understand LearnBuddy, local development, Docker deployment, and the main dependencies.

tour.title: Main Application Flow
tour.description: Read the client page, layout, and global CSS to see how profile capture, plan navigation, schedule, video support, and tutor chat are presented.

tour.title: Plan Generation
tour.description: Follow the plan route into the Law-RAG JSON helper and deterministic fallback generator to understand how personalized plans are created and normalized.

tour.title: Tutor And Video Support
tour.description: Inspect tutor and video routes, then the video index service, to see how chat answers, YouTube suggestions, transcript analysis, and lesson matches work.

tour.title: Configuration And Runtime
tour.description: Finish with TypeScript, Next.js, environment, Docker, and ignore configuration to understand how the app builds and runs.
